# FP-0002 legacy redirects
<IfModule mod_rewrite.c>
RewriteEngine On
RewriteRule ^yoga/?$ /o-centre/programma-lecheniya/kinezioterapiya/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^about/?$ /o-centre/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^psy/?$ /o-centre/programma-lecheniya/psihokorrektsiya/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^home/?$ /o-centre/programma-lecheniya/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^policy/?$ /privacy-policy/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^neuro/?$ /o-centre/programma-lecheniya/prostranstvo-vosstanovleniya/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^reviews/?$ /otzyvy/ [R=301,L]
# Specialists URL migration: force https host to avoid HTTP→HTTPS chain behind SSL proxy.
RewriteRule ^specyalisty/?$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/specialisty/ [R=301,L]
RewriteRule ^specyalisty/(.+?)/?$ https://%{HTTP_HOST}/specialisty/$1/ [R=301,L]
</IfModule>
